About Kumrat Valley

Kumrat is a deodar-forested valley on the Panjkora river, reached by a rough road from Thal and still refreshingly undeveloped. Wooden camps, waterfalls and the Katora Lake trek make it a favourite for campers who want forest rather than bare high mountain.

Visitor Notes

Best time to visit
May – September
Time needed
2-3 days
Good to know
Facilities are basic; book camps in advance in summer and carry cash, as card payment is rare.
